app.Q29oZXJl.short_desc.source: Chat, search, document extraction, audio transcription, and batch inference
app.Q29oZXJl.short_desc.message: 聊天、搜尋、文件擷取、音訊轉錄和批次推理

app.Q29oZXJl.desc.source:
Use [Cohere](https://cohere.com) to understand and retrieve business content.

- Generate grounded answers and call tools with chat models
- Embed text and images, and rerank search results
- Extract document images and transcribe recorded speech
- Upload datasets and manage embedding or inference batches
- Discover models and inspect model-specific tokens

A Cohere API key is required. Trial keys have a monthly quota; connection pings verify authentication separately from inference availability.
app.Q29oZXJl.desc.message:
使用 [Cohere](https://cohere.com) 來理解和檢索業務內容。

- 根據來源文件產生答案並使用聊天模型呼叫工具
- 嵌入文字和圖像，並對搜尋結果重新排名
- 擷取文件影像並轉錄錄製的語音
- 上傳資料集並管理嵌入或推理批次
- 發現模型並檢查模型特定的令牌

需要 Cohere API 金鑰。試用金鑰有每月配額；連接 ping 驗證身份驗證與推斷可用性分開。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.d.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Cohere** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.d.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **Cohere** 發出自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基本 URL）、選用查詢參數、標頭與請求內文。回應將作為包含狀態碼、回應標頭與回應內文的雜湊傳回。

對於此應用程式中尚未公開為一級動作的端點，請使用此動作。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量（字串/數字/布林值）的雜湊。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構（filename + content + mime_type）。架構會建立 multipart 封套並設定 boundary 標頭。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆蓋，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/form/YAML 期望雜湊，XML/text 期望字串，multipart 期望檔案結構，binary 期望原始位元組。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 代入 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}`，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。值均經過 URL 編碼。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會以 `,` 連接。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些標頭會覆蓋由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭（例如，在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值）。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 視為成功的 HTTP 狀態碼選擇性清單。若有設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作會拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。若未設定，則套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為（通常：2xx 為成功，非 2xx 則拋出例外）。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 正常傳回非 2xx 回應而非拋出例外

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx HTTP 回應會作為正常的相應雜湊傳回（帶有實際狀態碼），而非引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。有助於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 — 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆蓋連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 在回應中包含請求/計時/大小等除錯資訊

app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含 `debug` 子雜湊，其中含有請求方法/URL/標頭（敏感值已被隱藏）、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設為關閉以保持回應精簡。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.ZW1iZWQ.option.aW1hZ.source:
An array of image data URIs for the model to embed.

The image must be a valid [data URI](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/URI/Schemes/data). The image must be in either `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, or `image/gif` format.

Image embeddings are supported with Embed v3.0 and newer models.

For **Embed v3.x** models, the maximum number of images per call is `1`, and each image has a maximum size of `5MB`.

For **Embed v4.0 and newer** models, there is no limit on the number of images per call. The combined size of all images in the request must be at most `20MB`.

app.Q29oZXJl.action.ZW1iZWQ.option.aW5wd.source: Choose how the embeddings will be used

Specifies the type of input passed to the model. Required for embedding models v3 and higher.

- `"search_document"`: Used for embeddings stored in a vector database for search use-cases.
- `"search_query"`: Used for embeddings of search queries run against a vector DB to find relevant documents.
- `"classification"`: Used for embeddings passed through a text classifier.
- `"clustering"`: Used for the embeddings run through a clustering algorithm.
- `"image"`: Used for embeddings with image input.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.ZW1iZWQ.option.aW5wd.message:

- `"classification"`：用於透過文字分類器傳遞的嵌入。
- `"clustering"`：用於透過聚類演算法運行的嵌入。
- `"image"`：用於影像輸入的嵌入。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.ZW1iZWQ.option.ZW1iZ.source:
Specifies the types of embeddings you want to get back. Can be one or more of the following types.

* `"float"`: Use this when you want to get back the default float embeddings. Supported with all Embed models.
* `"int8"`: Use this when you want to get back signed int8 embeddings. Supported with Embed v3.0 and newer Embed models.
* `"uint8"`: Use this when you want to get back unsigned int8 embeddings. Supported with Embed v3.0 and newer Embed models.
* `"binary"`: Use this when you want to get back signed binary embeddings. Supported with Embed v3.0 and newer Embed models.
* `"ubinary"`: Use this when you want to get back unsigned binary embeddings. Supported with Embed v3.0 and newer Embed models.
* `"base64"`: Use this when you want to get back base64 embeddings. Supported with Embed v3.0 and newer Embed models.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.ZW1iZWQ.option.ZW1iZ.message:
指定您想要傳回的嵌入類型。可以是以下類型中的一種或多種。

* `"float"`：當您想要恢復預設的浮動嵌入時，請使用此選項。所有嵌入型號均支援。
* `"int8"`：當您想要取回已簽署的 int8 嵌入時，請使用此選項。支援 Embed v3.0 和更新的 Embed 型號。
* `"uint8"`：當您想要取回無符號 int8 嵌入時，請使用此選項。支援 Embed v3.0 和更新的 Embed 型號。
* `"binary"`：當您想要取回已簽署的二進位嵌入時，請使用此選項。支援 Embed v3.0 和更新的 Embed 型號。
* `"ubinary"`：當您想要取回未簽署的二進位嵌入時，請使用此選項。支援 Embed v3.0 和更新的 Embed 型號。
* `"base64"`：當您想要取回 Base64 嵌入時使用此選項。支援 Embed v3.0 和更新的 Embed 型號。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y2xhc3NpZnk.option.a.source:
A list of up to 96 texts to be classified. Each one must be a non-empty string.
There is, however, no consistent, universal limit to the length a particular input can be. We perform classification on the first `x` tokens of each input, and `x` varies depending on which underlying model is powering classification. The maximum token length for each model is listed in the "max tokens" column [here](https://docs.cohere.com/docs/models).
Note: by default the `truncate` parameter is set to `END`, so tokens exceeding the limit will be automatically dropped. This behavior can be disabled by setting `truncate` to `NONE`, which will result in validation errors for longer texts.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y2xhc3NpZnk.option.a.message:
最多包含 96 個待分類文字的清單。每一項都必須是非空字串。
然而，對於特定輸入的長度沒有一致的、通用的限制。我們對每個輸入的第一個 `x` 標記執行分類，並且 `x` 根據支援分類的底層模型而變化。每個模型的最大令牌長度列在「最大令牌」列中[此處](https://docs.cohere.com/docs/models)。
注意：預設情況下，`truncate` 參數設定為 `END`，因此超出限制的令牌將自動丟棄。可以透過將 `truncate` 設定為 `NONE` 來停用此行為，這將導致較長文字的驗證錯誤。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y2xhc3NpZnk.option.Z.source:
An array of examples to provide context to the model. Each example is a text string and its associated label/class. Each unique label requires at least 2 examples associated with it; the maximum number of examples is 2500, and each example has a maximum length of 512 tokens. The values should be structured as `{text: "...",label: "..."}`.
Note: [Fine-tuned Models](https://docs.cohere.com/docs/classify-fine-tuning) trained on classification examples don't require the `examples` parameter to be passed in explicitly.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y2xhc3NpZnk.option.Z.message:
為模型提供上下文的一組範例。每個範例都是一個文字字串及其關聯的標籤/類別。每個獨特的標籤需要至少 2 個與之關聯的範例；範例的最大數量為 2500，每個範例的最大長度為 512 個標記。這些值的結構應為 `{text: "...",label: "..."}`。
注意：在分類範例上訓練的[微調模型](https://docs.cohere.com/docs/classify-fine-tuning) 不需要明確傳入 `examples` 參數。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.source:
Specifies the type of input passed to the model. Required for embedding models v3 and higher.

- `"search_document"`: Used for embeddings stored in a vector database for search use-cases.
- `"search_query"`: Used for embeddings of search queries run against a vector DB to find relevant documents.
- `"classification"`: Used for embeddings passed through a text classifier.
- `"clustering"`: Used for the embeddings run through a clustering algorithm.
- `"image"`: Used for embeddings with image input.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.message:
指定傳遞給模型的輸入類型。嵌入模型 v3 及更高版本所需。

- `"search_document"`：用於儲存在向量資料庫中的嵌入，用於搜尋用例。
- `"search_query"`：用於嵌入針對向量資料庫執行的搜尋查詢以尋找相關文件。
- `"classification"`：用於透過文字分類器傳遞的嵌入。
- `"clustering"`：用於透過聚類演算法運行的嵌入。
- `"image"`：用於影像輸入的嵌入。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.source:
Specifies the types of embeddings you want to get back. Not required and default is None, which returns the Embed Floats response type. Can be one or more of the following types.

* `"float"`: Use this when you want to get back the default float embeddings. Valid for all models.
* `"int8"`: Use this when you want to get back signed int8 embeddings. Valid for v3 and newer model versions.
* `"uint8"`: Use this when you want to get back unsigned int8 embeddings. Valid for v3 and newer model versions.
* `"binary"`: Use this when you want to get back signed binary embeddings. Valid for v3 and newer model versions.
* `"ubinary"`: Use this when you want to get back unsigned binary embeddings. Valid for v3 and newer model versions.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.message:
指定您想要傳回的嵌入類型。不是必需的，預設值為 None，它會傳回 Embed Floats 回應類型。可以是以下類型中的一種或多種。

* `"float"`：當您想要恢復預設的浮動嵌入時，請使用此選項。適用於所有型號。
* `"int8"`：當您想要取回已簽署的 int8 嵌入時，請使用此選項。適用於 v3 及更新的型號版本。
* `"uint8"`：當您想要取回無符號 int8 嵌入時，請使用此選項。適用於 v3 及更新的型號版本。
* `"binary"`：當您想要取回已簽署的二進位嵌入時，請使用此選項。適用於 v3 及更新的型號版本。
* `"ubinary"`：當您想要取回未簽署的二進位嵌入時，請使用此選項。適用於 v3 及更新的型號版本。

app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.source: One of 'START|END' to specify how the API will handle inputs longer than the…
app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.message: 「START|END」之一指定 API 如何處理長於…的輸入

app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.source:
One of `START|END` to specify how the API will handle inputs longer than the maximum token length.

Passing `START` will discard the start of the input. `END` will discard the end of the input. In both cases, input is discarded until the remaining input is exactly the maximum input token length for the model.
app.Q29oZXJl.action.Y3JlYXRlLWVtYmVkLWpv.message:
`START|END` 之一，用於指定 API 如何處理長於最大令牌長度的輸入。

傳遞 `START` 將丟棄輸入的開頭。 `END` 將丟棄輸入的末尾。在這兩種情況下，輸入都會被丟棄，直到剩餘輸入恰好是模型的最大輸入標記長度。
